name: Charmeleon

abilities.name: Ignition
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a {Fire} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active {Fire} Pokémon.

flavor:
It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly
seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression
will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.
